ModMetaData.name: Giddy-Up 2 1.5 ReverseLookup Hotfix
ModMetaData.author: Allen / OpenAI
ModMetaData.description: RimWorld 1.5 hotfix for Giddy-Up 2 ReverseLookup warning spam. Preserves successful reservation lookups and the original false/fallback result on misses while avoiding repeated warning log spam. Fails closed to original Giddy-Up behavior if the target structure differs.
